cards.ex: The museum puts on a living history display every summer, with actors in period costumes.
cards.exUz: Muzey har yozda jonli tarix ko'rgazmasini tashkil qiladi, aktyorlar davr liboslarida.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishni hozirgi zamonda namoyish etish, ko'rgazmali tarzda jonlantirish.

cards.ex: The photographs evoked memories of a bygone era.
cards.exUz: Suratlar o'tgan davr xotiralarini uyg'otdi.
cards.uzDef: Eski, o'tib ketgan bir davrni anglatadi.

cards.ex: We need to protect our cultural heritage for future generations.
cards.exUz: Kelajak avlodlar uchun madaniy merosimizni himoya qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Millatning tarixiy va madaniy qadriyatlari.

cards.ex: This tradition can be traced back to the 18th century.
cards.exUz: Bu an'ananing kelib chiqishini 18-asrga borib taqash mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning qayerdan kelib chiqqanini aniqlash.

cards.ex: The monument serves as a reminder of the collective memory of the war.
cards.exUz: Yodgorlik urushning umumiy xotirasini eslatib turadi.
cards.uzDef: Guruh yoki jamiyatning umumiy o'tmishi haqidagi xotiralari.

cards.ex: The site has great historical significance because of the battle that took place there.
cards.exUz: Bu joyda bo'lib o'tgan jang tufayli katta tarixiy ahamiyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Biror voqea yoki joyning tarix uchun muhimligi.

cards.ex: It's important to preserve the past so we can learn from it.
cards.exUz: O'tmishni saqlash muhim, shunda undan saboq olishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi narsalarni buzilmasdan saqlab qolish.

cards.ex: The Eiffel Tower is a famous historical landmark.
cards.exUz: Eyfel minorasi mashhur tarixiy obida hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy ahamiyatga ega bo'lgan joy yoki bino.

cards.ex: Language is a key element of cultural identity.
cards.exUz: Til madaniy o'zlikning asosiy elementidir.
cards.uzDef: Bir guruhning madaniy xususiyatlari va e'tiqodlari.

cards.ex: The area is rich in folklore and legends about mythical creatures.
cards.exUz: Bu hudud mifologik maxluqlar haqidagi afsonalar va rivoyatlarga boy.
cards.uzDef: Xalq og'zaki ijodidagi hikoyalar va afsonalar.

cards.ex: Many stories have been passed down through oral tradition.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina hikoyalar og'zaki an'ana orqali avloddan avlodga o'tgan.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni og'zaki ravishda avloddan avlodga o'tkazish.

cards.ex: The community still upholds many of its old traditions.
cards.exUz: Jamiyat hali ham o'zining ko'plab eski an'analarini saqlab kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: An'analarga sodiq qolish va ularni davom ettirish.

cards.ex: The book provides a detailed historical account of the war.
cards.exUz: Kitobda urush haqida batafsil tarixiy hisobot berilgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror voqeaning tarixiy jihatdan tasviri.

cards.ex: The park was built in memory of the victims of the disaster.
cards.exUz: Park ofat qurbonlari xotirasiga bag'ishlab qurilgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishini xotirlash uchun.

cards.ex: The old clock is a relic of the past.
cards.exUz: Eski soat o'tmish yodgorligidir.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdan qolgan qadimiy narsa.

cards.ex: Visiting the old city gave me a real sense of history.
cards.exUz: Eski shaharga tashrif buyurish menga haqiqiy tarix tuyg'usini berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishni anglash va uning ahamiyatini his qilish.

cards.ex: This recipe has been passed down in our family for generations.
cards.exUz: Bu retsept bizning oilamizda avloddan avlodga meros qilib o'tkazilgan.
cards.uzDef: Avloddan avlodga o'tkazish (meros sifatida).

cards.ex: The country's culture has deep historical roots.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat madaniyati chuqur tarixiy ildizlarga ega.
cards.uzDef: Bir narsaning kelib chiqishi yoki asosiy sabablari.

cards.ex: Respect for elders is an important cultural value.
cards.exUz: Kattalarni hurmat qilish muhim madaniy qadriyatdir.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyat tomonidan qadrlanadigan e'tiqodlar va tamoyillar.

cards.ex: It's time to turn the page and focus on the future.
cards.exUz: Endi yangi sahifa ochib, kelajakka e'tibor qaratish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishni unutib, yangi hayot boshlash.

cards.ex: His art is a living legacy that continues to inspire.
cards.exUz: Uning san'ati ilhomlantirishda davom etayotgan tirik merosdir.
cards.uzDef: Bugungi kunda ham ta'sirini ko'rsatayotgan meros.

cards.ex: We must learn from history so we don't repeat the same mistakes.
cards.exUz: Biz tarixdan saboq olishimiz kerak, shunda xuddi shu xatolarni takrorlamaymiz.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi xatolardan saboq chiqarib, kelajakda takrorlamaslik.

cards.ex: Winning the Olympics filled the country with national pride.
cards.exUz: Olimpiadada g'alaba qozonish mamlakatni milliy iftixorga to'ldirdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z millatiga mansublikdan g'ururlanish tuyg'usi.

cards.ex: The program promotes cultural exchange between students from different countries.
cards.exUz: Dastur turli mamlakatlardan kelgan talabalar o'rtasida madaniy almashinuvni rag'batlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Turli madaniyatlar o'rtasida ma'lumot va tajriba almashish.

cards.ex: The sands of time continue to flow, changing everything.
cards.exUz: Vaqt o'tishi davom etadi, hamma narsani o'zgartiradi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtning o'tishi, tez o'tib ketishi.

cards.ex: She enjoys reading historical fiction set in ancient Rome.
cards.exUz: U qadimgi Rimda bo'lib o'tadigan tarixiy fantastikani o'qishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Tarixiy voqealarni fantastik elementlar bilan aralashtirgan janr.

cards.ex: They returned to their ancestral home after many years abroad.
cards.exUz: Ular ko'p yillar chet elda yashagandan so'ng ajdodlar uyiga qaytishdi.
cards.uzDef: Oilaning avloddan avlodga meros bo'lib o'tgan uyi.

cards.ex: It's important to understand the historical context to appreciate the novel.
cards.exUz: Romanni qadrlash uchun tarixiy kontekstni tushunish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Voqeaning sodir bo'lgan davridagi sharoitlar va vaziyat.

cards.ex: The battle was a turning point in the war.
cards.exUz: Bu jang urushda burilish nuqtasi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Voqealar rivojida muhim o'zgarishga olib kelgan nuqta.

cards.ex: The festival pays homage to the country's founders.
cards.exUz: Festival mamlakat asoschilariga hurmat bajo keltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Kimgadir yoki nimagadir hurmat ko'rsatmoq.
